answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 60519 Country: Pakistan Title: Using images of living beings in website designing Question: I am a website and stationary designer. Can I use images of living beings (people or animals etc) in my design if the images are provided to me by my clients? Answer ID: 60519 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 631/631/SD=10/1436) It is severe sin in the Shariah to photograph the pictures of living beings or get it photographed by someone else. Using the picture of living being in the design is unlawful and haram. Hence you should not use the picture of living beings in your design. In case a customer wants to add any living picture in his design, you should reject it politely. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
